summary: Anthropic announced a $65 billion Series H funding round at a $965 billion post-money valuation, alongside new multi-gigawatt compute agreements with Amazon, Google/Broadcom, and SpaceX, and strategic partnerships with Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix.

mechanisms.reason: A $65B raise at a $965B valuation materially expands Anthropic's capital available to commit to future compute.
mechanisms.quote: Anthropic has raised $65 billion in Series H funding... valuing the company at $965 billion post-money.

mechanisms.reason: New agreements for up to ten gigawatts of new compute capacity directly translate into datacentre power demand.
mechanisms.quote: We signed agreements with Amazon for up to five gigawatts of new capacity, with Google and Broadcom for five gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity

mechanisms.reason: The disclosed multi-gigawatt cluster commitments across AWS, Google/Broadcom and SpaceX represent a large expansion of training and serving compute.
mechanisms.quote: We have significantly expanded our compute capacity in recent weeks.

mechanisms.reason: Anthropic is contracting for next-generation TPU capacity co-developed with Broadcom, expanding use of custom/ASIC silicon alongside merchant GPUs.
mechanisms.quote: with Google and Broadcom for five gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity

mechanisms.reason: Rapid revenue growth and stated enterprise adoption imply rising inference volume being served.
mechanisms.quote: our run-rate revenue crossed $47 billion earlier this month

categories.reason: Micron, Samsung and SK hynix are named as strategic infrastructure partners supplying memory, storage and logic for Anthropic's compute scale-up.
categories.quote: strategic infrastructure partners — Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix — whose technologies play a critical role in the world's supply of memory, storage, and logic chips

categories.reason: The Google/Broadcom TPU capacity agreement expands custom AI accelerator deployment tied to Anthropic's demand.
categories.quote: with Google and Broadcom for five gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity

categories.reason: Amazon, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure are named as cloud platforms hosting Claude, with AWS as primary training partner and a $5B hyperscaler investment.
categories.quote: Claude is the first frontier model available on all three of the world's largest cloud platforms: Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. AWS remains our primary cloud provider and training partner.

categories.reason: A new agreement with SpaceX gives Anthropic access to GPU capacity hosted in SpaceX's Colossus data centers.
categories.quote: agreements... with SpaceX for access to GPU capacity in Colossus 1 and Colossus 2

notable_reason: A $65B raise at a $965B valuation combined with multi-gigawatt compute commitments across three hyperscalers and custom silicon is a scale of capital and infrastructure commitment that resets expectations for the sector.
